content.title: About
content.content: Breakfast Tart, Lowfat is a light pastry made from whole‑grain flour, fat‑free cottage cheese and egg whites. It contains minimal saturated fat while remaining flavorful and nutritious, making it ideal for a morning meal.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The tart is prepared without butter, cutting the calorie count by almost half compared with traditional versions.
Fat‑free cottage cheese provides a good source of calcium and protein.
It is often served with berry sauce or fresh fruit, boosting vitamin and antioxidant content.
Egg whites give the tart structure without adding extra fat.

items.title: Low Fat Content
items.content: The tart contains less than 5 g of fat per 100 g, suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Rich in Protein
items.content: Cottage cheese and egg whites supply about 12 g of protein per serving, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Calcium Source
items.content: Provides calcium important for bone and teeth health.

items.title: Low Glycemic Index
items.content: Whole‑grain flour slows carbohydrate absorption, helping maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: B‑Vitamin Rich
items.content: Egg whites and whole‑grain flour contain B2, B6 and folate, essential for energy metabolism.

items.title: Egg Allergy
items.content: The tart contains egg whites, which may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Lactose Content
items.content: Fat‑free cottage cheese may contain trace lactose; those with intolerance should choose a lactose‑free alternative.

items.title: Sodium
items.content: Some recipes add a small amount of salt; limit intake if you need to control sodium.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the tart warm or cold, sliced into portions. Serve with low‑fat yogurt, berry sauce, or fresh fruit. For a more filling breakfast, add a side of nuts or seeds.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the tart in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze it in a separate bag – it retains flavor and texture for up to 2 months. Reheat in the oven 5‑10 minutes at 180 °C before serving.
